observations: Photo 0 shows two car headlight assemblies, one above the other, placed on a tiled floor. Both have clear lenses with circular main bulbs and smaller auxiliary bulbs. The top headlight has a black plastic housing with visible mounting brackets and a small green object in the background. The bottom headlight has a slightly different lens design with a more pronounced inner ring.

Photo 1 shows a front grille with a central Toyota emblem, black vertical slats, and a chrome trim on the outer edges. The grille is placed on a tiled floor, with a green object and a cardboard box in the background.
The headlight assemblies in photo 0 appear to be from the same vehicle based on design similarity, but no visible branding or model identifiers are readable on the parts themselves.
The grille in photo 1 is clearly a Toyota grille, but no model or year is visible. The design is consistent with a mid-2000s to early 2010s Toyota SUV or sedan.
